changed_factors: Declare technique-owned prior_mechanism swapping task MoGParticlePrior for unstandardized ParticlePrior wrapped with NormalNoiseManipulator (sigma=0.005 on stochastic tasks, deterministic sigma=0.0 on enumerated particle-cloud image tasks)
Keep the entire public atlas preset recipe unchanged (recipe_overrides={}) so the prior mechanism swap is the sole trainer delta against control atlas
mechanism_rationale: MoG standardization couples all rows through batch/table moments, breaking feature-cell locality and independent birth/death transport. Replacing MoGParticlePrior with an unstandardized ParticlePrior plus an additive NormalNoiseManipulator (sigma=0.005, matched to the unclustered particle Voronoi cell scale so BoundedLatentGeometry sorted-rank neighbor windows stay intact) preserves strict identity row Jacobians (row_local_gradients=True, a2_eligible=True) and isolated prior_noise_generator draws.
